scope: Development follow-up on already inspected data; not a fresh confirmatory holdout
forecast: One day ahead from day4; use only earlier days in focal camp. Other-camp baseline excludes all focal camp observations. All forecasts evaluated on identical eligible rows.
fit: Fit daily increments by positive bounded nonlinear least squares using only available local history. Same bounds and three starts as prior development test. Failure falls back to local mean and is counted.
scores: paired camp-bootstrap differences against each baseline
bootstrap: 2000 resamples of whole evaluable camps, seed20260919; percentile95% interval; descriptive small-sample uncertainty only
selection: No candidate tuning after scores. A candidate proceeds only if its RMSE beats every baseline and its paired bootstrap difference upper bound is below zero against every baseline. Still requires independent population and relocation evaluation.
leakage_checks: Each prediction records history end < target day. Changing future target values must leave that forecast unchanged. Changing other-camp observations cannot alter local-only model forecasts.
limitations: Camp3 has only3 days and cannot be evaluated after warmup
No observations after departure; scores conditional on remaining in camp
Return forecasts do not validate departure timing
Same population and overlapping development data
